related.title: 托內斯進步型氣冷反應爐電廠
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；托內斯進步型氣冷反應爐電廠的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Torness Advanced Gas-Cooled Reactor Station must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦第一座工業規模供電的核電廠：鎂合金護套的溫度限制、氣體循環機、鋼製壓力容器與長期除役；托內斯進步型氣冷反應爐電廠則以進步型氣冷反應爐：高溫二氧化碳、預力混凝土壓力容器、石墨老化與海生物堵塞為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the first nuclear station to supply power on an industrial scale: the Magnox cladding limit, gas circulators, steel pressure vessels and long decommissioning; Torness Advanced Gas-Cooled Reactor Station centres on the advanced gas-cooled reactor: hot carbon dioxide, a prestressed concrete pressure vessel, graphite ageing and marine ingress, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」與「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「低壓氣體與循環機耗電」的模型移到托內斯進步型氣冷反應爐電廠，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「石墨磚裂紋與壽命限制」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency" and "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency".
Move the model of "Low-pressure gas and circulator power" to Torness Advanced Gas-Cooled Reactor Station, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Graphite brick cracking and the limit on life", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；托內斯進步型氣冷反應爐電廠的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Torness Advanced Gas-Cooled Reactor Station must be respecified.

related.title: 希平港核電廠除役工程
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；希平港核電廠除役工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Shippingport Atomic Power Station Decommissioning must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦第一座工業規模供電的核電廠：鎂合金護套的溫度限制、氣體循環機、鋼製壓力容器與長期除役；希平港核電廠除役工程則以美國首座完整除役的商用規模反應爐：壓力槽整體移除、萬里駁運與成本為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the first nuclear station to supply power on an industrial scale: the Magnox cladding limit, gas circulators, steel pressure vessels and long decommissioning; Shippingport Atomic Power Station Decommissioning centres on the first commercial-scale reactor fully decommissioned in the United States: one-piece vessel removal, a long barge voyage and cost, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」與「壓力槽的整件移除」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「低壓氣體與循環機耗電」的模型移到希平港核電廠除役工程，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「廠址解除管制的標準」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency" and "Removing the vessel in one piece".
Move the model of "Low-pressure gas and circulator power" to Shippingport Atomic Power Station Decommissioning, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "The standard for releasing a site", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；希平港核電廠除役工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Shippingport Atomic Power Station Decommissioning must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 卡德霍爾鎂諾克斯核電廠
history.text: 1953 年工程開工；1956 年啟用並向電網供電；2003 年停止發電；2007 年冷卻塔拆除；2019 年燃料全數移出。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 1953: Construction began. 1956: Opened and supplying the grid. 2003: Generation ended. 2007: The cooling towers were demolished. 2019: Defuelling was completed. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
